text: This is happy map. It plans a walk across Toronto by what you are exposed to, not only by how long it takes.
Minutes outdoors in January. Metres of direct sun in July. Stairs, missing sidewalks, and subway elevators that are out of service right now.
Every route is shown next to the fastest one, so the trade-off is never hidden.
From Scotiabank Arena to the Eaton Centre, the indoor route spends sixteen metres outdoors instead of eight hundred, for one extra minute.
And since the first of September, a server has logged every elevator outage on the T T C, so the app is judged by data, not by claims.
